partition_unit: connected components over the full current parent universe where parents share parent_document_id OR extraction_source_text_sha256; every selected component contributes its complete parent-level vector to every constraint
exclusions: authenticate and union every prior endorsement tuning, pilot, preflight, stress, completed-validation, A3, and residual parent; raw-text-only pilot rows map by authenticated raw_text_sha256; then exclude every complete duplicate-content component touching the union

sealed_release_candidate_pool.canonical_selector: globally feasible lexicographically minimum ordered component-rank vector under exact parent-weighted quotas; branch order is traversal only, every choice preserves feasibility, and incomplete proof or whole-component overshoot fails
sealed_release_candidate_pool.rank: SHA-256 of compact sorted-key JSON containing seed, ordered component parent identities and source hashes, and component count vectors
sealed_release_candidate_pool.access: no reserve or pilot IDs, source text, tasks, model strata, or results are exposed before the 40 predictions freeze; reserve content is never inspected for tuning

later_final_20.party_minima: D=min(6,N_D), R=min(6,N_R), O=min(2,N_O), computed within the sealed80 before the final draw
later_final_20.model_output_zero: all frozen Stage-B batches for the parent are technically complete, with zero withheld and zero validated publicly aligned endorsement records
later_final_20.model_output_multi: all frozen Stage-B batches for the parent are technically complete, with zero withheld, and the frozen input manifest contains at least two distinct batch_ids for that parent
later_final_20.selector: exact whole-component branch-and-bound; globally lexicographically minimum feasible ranked vector; no replacement, relaxation, reranking, or seed change
later_final_20.failure: infeasibility or validation failure blocks that release version; a later attempt requires a newly frozen independent reserve contract

pilot.boundaries: q25/q75 are nearest-rank character quartiles over all eligible legacy-positive one-window parents before either partition; D is the remaining middle and short-line density is an objective tie-break
pilot.compound_source_pattern: at least one physical line is accepted by exact _compound_anchor_expected_names
pilot.context: source_scope exactly page_or_section_route_context; direct support uses the frozen SUPPORT regex after URL removal
pilot.party_normalization: NFKC, strip, casefold; democrat/democratic/d=D; republican/gop/r=R; all other/null/blank=O
pilot.party_minima: D=min(12,N_D), R=min(12,N_R), O=min(4,N_O), computed before selection
pilot.feasibility: one exact mixed-integer binary component-vector problem jointly assigns disjoint reserve and pilot components and proves every quota, minimum, and cap
pilot.year_bins: Y0_NULL contains null year; non-null nearest-rank q25,q50,q75 cutpoints use <= in order, so repeated cutpoints may produce empty bins
pilot.canonical_selector: among all jointly feasible assignments use exact precedence: lexicographically minimize the reserve component-rank vector; minimize pilot maximum count across Y0_NULL,Y1,Y2,Y3,Y4; minimize squared deviations of those five counts from eight; maximize integer D-stratum density_ppm sum; lexicographically minimize the pilot component-rank vector; every stage must prove gap zero or fail

human_recall_scoring.coding: after predictions freeze, a human codes exhaustive endorser name parent offsets and support/context parent offsets, or true_zero; no semantic-field coding
human_recall_scoring.name_normalization: Unicode NFKC; CRLF and LF each become one ASCII space; collapse ASCII spaces; strip; casefold; never delete punctuation, NBSP, diacritics, nicknames, or tokens
human_recall_scoring.edge: an occurrence and record form an edge only when record_evidence parent coordinates contain exact coded name coordinates and normalized names agree; support passes only when coded support/context coordinates are contained by that record's record_evidence or endorsement_context_evidence coordinates
human_recall_scoring.matching: maximum-cardinality bipartite matching over coordinate-distinct human occurrences and model records; among maxima choose lexicographically by exact offset equality, smallest evidence span, batch_id, slot, record_index, human start, human end; greedy is forbidden
human_recall_scoring.denominators: recall uses all coded nonzero occurrences; completeness all 40 parents; support every matched occurrence; true-zero requires zero model records
human_recall_scoring.technical_failure: fails deterministic validity and page completeness and is never scored as zero

failure: freeze a failed audit, exclude every sampled duplicate component, revise the route, and draw an untouched round with seed 20260827+1000*r under a pre-frozen contract; never repair sampled rows into a pass

authorization.boundary: a passing 40 may support consideration of full private endorsement inference; independent human semantic validation still blocks release
